title: Voice sign-in asks for spoken email and keeps confirmation, private OTP and shared microphone
steps: Run the listed Node and own headless browser fixtures. Speech, OTP, TTS and APIs are synthetic; never send email, call cloud providers or touch the user browser.
expect: EN and VI guides ask the person to say their email, then confirm before requesting a code, including regional language tags.
Spoken email fills the panel and is read back; no OTP request occurs before yes or đúng.
Spoken six digits verify once on the same microphone, with no credentials in model turns or sessionStorage; the next normal utterance resumes website context.
Rejected email, partial code, paused listening and stale code callbacks after Google/phase changes never submit a code.
fence: Explicit email confirmation, epoch-bound OTP timer and speech cursor routing; browser fixtures do not establish canonical STT/TTS acceptance.

tests: spoken auth happy path fills email, confirms before OTP, verifies six digits and resumes without a model turn
email rejection does not send OTP; paused or changed-phase queued code cannot verify
voice sign-in confirms the spoken email and verifies OTP without replacing the microphone
Vietnamese regional voice guide accepts spoken confirmation and six digits on the same microphone
